name: everydaycash.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: www.everydaycash.com scores 56 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /post-category/view?slug=daily-budget, /post-category/view?slug=smart-shopping, /post-category/view?slug=extra-income and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /post-category/view?slug=daily-budget, /post-category/view?slug=smart-shopping, for example #search-btn. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _gcl_au.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 40 elements on /, /post-category/view?slug=daily-budget, /post-category/view?slug=smart-shopping, for example .article-top__image-wrap and .article-top__btn. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 614 ms
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
